_comment: AG OSS alternate-port runtime config. Use when the identuum-ag (monolith) container owns 7213-7215 and AG OSS runs on 73xx as a host process.
_comment_ag_oss_workflow: Pair with identuum-ag-oss/make dev-run-app-alt (defaults: agent 7313, identity 7314, management 7315).
_comment_internal_base_url: host.docker.internal resolves to the macOS host loopback under Docker Desktop and OrbStack.
_comment_select: Selected at container start via IDENTUUM_UI_CONFIG_FILE=/app/config/ui-runtime.ag-oss-alt.json — see deployment/docker-compose.local.ag-oss-alt.yml.
